entries.headline: U.S. military fires missiles at commercial ship in Iran conflict
entries.summary: A U.S. Navy helicopter shot missiles into a cargo ship's engine room after it tried to break a U.S. naval blockade on Iranian ports. The ship had ignored orders to turn back.
entries.why: This is a sharp military escalation involving direct armed strikes against commercial shipping during an active conflict.
